title: Sending a Package to Grandma
passage:
Amy's grandmother's birthday is tomorrow, so Amy and her brother Tom go to the post office to send her a package.
The clerk weighs the box and says, "Standard mail is cheaper, but it takes five days to arrive." Tom looks worried. "That's too slow! Grandma's birthday is tomorrow."
The clerk smiles. "Express mail is faster. It only takes one day, but it's more expensive than standard mail."
Amy thinks for a moment. "We had better send it by express mail. We don't want to be late."
"Good idea," says Tom. "Is the gift fragile?"
"Yes, it's a glass photo frame," Amy says. "Please pack it carefully."
The clerk checks the address on the package and nods. "Don't worry. We will deliver it in time for her birthday."
Amy and Tom pay for the express mail and leave the post office happily. They know Grandma will be surprised and happy when she opens her gift tomorrow.

grammar: 比較級形容詞 (comparative adjectives)：兩者比較時，形容詞加 -er 或用 more + 形容詞，後接 than，例如 cheaper than、more expensive than。
had better + 原形動詞：用來給建議或忠告，語氣比 should 更強烈，否定為 had better not。
It takes + 時間 + to + 原形動詞：表示「做某事需要花多少時間」的句型。

reading.q: Why do Amy and Tom go to the post office?
opts: To send a birthday package to their grandmother
To mail a letter to their teacher
reading.ex: 文章開頭提到 Amy 的奶奶生日快到了，所以 Amy 和 Tom 去郵局寄包裹給奶奶，答案為 B。

reading.q: What does the clerk say about standard mail?
opts: It is faster but more expensive
It is cheaper but takes five days
It cannot be used for fragile items
It only works for addresses in Tainan
reading.ex: 店員說 "Standard mail is cheaper, but it takes five days to arrive."，普通郵件比較便宜但要五天，答案為 B。

reading.q: Why does Tom think standard mail is not a good choice?
opts: Grandma's birthday is tomorrow, so it's too slow
The post office is closed tomorrow
reading.ex: Tom 說 "That's too slow! Grandma's birthday is tomorrow."，因為奶奶明天生日，普通郵件太慢了，答案為 C。
Amy 說 "it's a glass photo frame"，禮物是玻璃相框，答案為 C。

reading.q: How does the clerk promise to help Amy and Tom?
opts: By delivering the package in time for the birthday
By repacking the gift for free
reading.ex: 店員說 "We will deliver it in time for her birthday."，承諾會及時送達，答案為 B。

grammar.q: Express mail is ___ than standard mail.
grammar.ex: 兩者比較用比較級，多音節形容詞用 more + 形容詞 + than，故選 more expensive，答案為 B。

grammar.q: It ___ five days for standard mail to arrive.
grammar.ex: 主詞 It 為第三人稱單數，現在時態用 takes，句型為 It takes + 時間 + to V，答案為 B。

grammar.q: You ___ send it by express mail if you want it to arrive quickly.
grammar.ex: had better 後面直接加原形動詞，不加 to，故選 had better，答案為 A。

grammar.q: Of the two mailing choices, express mail is ___.
grammar.ex: 只比較兩者時用比較級 faster，而非最高級 fastest，答案為 B。

grammar.q: We had better ___ careful with fragile items.
grammar.ex: had better 後接原形動詞 be，不可加 to 或變化型，答案為 A。

vocab.ex: weigh 作動詞意為「稱重」，例如店員用磅秤稱包裹重量，答案為 A。

vocab.q: This vase is ___, so please be careful.
vocab.ex: fragile 意為「易碎的」，花瓶易碎需要小心，答案為 A。
in time 意為「及時，趕得上」，例如及時送達給奶奶，答案為 B。

vocab.q: The person who works at the post office counter is called a ___.
vocab.ex: clerk 指「店員、辦事員」，在郵局櫃檯工作的人稱為 clerk，答案為 A。
deliver 作動詞意為「投遞、送達」，例如郵差將包裹送達目的地，答案為 B。
